beats.texto: Hi! I am a scene written as a script, not a timeline.
beats.visual: The robot waves on «Hi» and smiles.

beats.texto: Every move waits for a spoken word.
beats.visual: On «word» the robot points up and a label appears.

beats.texto: When I say push, this ball rolls away.
beats.visual: The hand reaches the ball and, on «push», the ball rolls to the right.

beats.texto: When I say charge, my antenna lights up.
beats.visual: On «charge» the antenna light and the chest meter fill up.

beats.texto: Overlaps and late moves are caught before rendering.
beats.visual: A checklist draws its tick on «caught»; the robot looks at it.

beats.texto: Write the words. The timing takes care of itself.
beats.visual: The robot returns to rest, happy, with the antenna still lit.
